# EDU-MMCS: Educational Courses of Southern Federal University Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science

> > Comprehensive online learning platform providing university-level courses in mathematics, computer science, and IT from SFedU's Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science.

EDU-MMCS is the official educational portal for the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science (мехмат) at Southern Federal University (ЮФУ) in Russia. It serves as a centralized hub for accessing degree programs, specialized courses, and educational resources across multiple disciplines including applied mathematics, fundamental computer science, and mathematical education.

## Key Topics

- Southern Federal University (ЮФУ)
- Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science (мехмат ЮФУ)
- Applied Mathematics and Computer Science
- Fundamental Computer Science and IT
- Machine Learning
- Java Programming
- Mathematics Education
- Computer Science Education
- Online Learning Platform
- Degree Programs
- Course Catalog
- Semester Schedule
- Educational Programs
- Sunday Computer School (Воскресная компьютерная школа)
- Laboratory of Mathematical Online Education

## Core Platform

- [EDU-MMCS Homepage](https://edu.mmcs.sfedu.ru): Main entry point for SFedU Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science courses and educational resources
- [Course Catalog and Categories](https://edu.mmcs.sfedu.ru/course/index.php): Complete catalog of available courses organized by category, degree program, and specialization

## Access and Authentication

- [Login and Site Access](https://edu.mmcs.sfedu.ru/calendar/view.php): Authentication portal for accessing course materials, schedules, and personalized educational content
